offers.title: 20% off your first order
offers.description: New customers can use this one-time welcome code online or in the app.
offers.terms: For first orders only; discount excludes delivery and tax. Product exclusions apply. Cannot be combined with another offer.

offers.title: 10% off orders over $80
offers.description: A public discount for eligible US orders above $80.
offers.terms: Order value must exceed $80. Savings capped at $100. Additional exclusions appear at checkout.

offers.title: Extra 20% off eligible purchases
offers.description: Use this code on coupon-eligible items.
offers.terms: One use per customer. Other percentage coupons cannot be combined. Excludes gift cards, delivery, taxes, charitable items, Sephora and ineligible brands.

offers.title: $20 off eligible purchases of $100 or more
offers.description: Meet the qualifying pre-tax minimum in a single transaction.
offers.terms: One use per customer. Applied before percentage coupons. When stacking offers, all minimum spending requirements must be met. Product and brand exclusions apply.

offers.title: $10 off qualifying home purchases of $50 or more
offers.terms: Rewards membership required. Sign into the linked account online. Minimum $50 qualifying spend before tax; one use per customer. Exclusions apply.

offers.title: Extra 30% off with a Kohl’s Card
offers.description: For existing cardholders buying coupon-eligible items.
offers.terms: Payment with a Kohl’s Card required. One use per customer. Cannot combine with another percentage coupon. Sephora and other item exclusions apply.

offers.title: Extra 30% off select categories
offers.description: Eligible clothing, shoes, accessories, fine jewelry, bed linens, bath items and curtains.
offers.terms: Online code for selected items only. Brand and product exclusions apply; consult the official offer details for dates and eligibility.

offers.title: Extra 30% off selected jewelry
offers.description: Cardholders may qualify for 35% off instead.
offers.terms: Selected fine and fashion jewelry only. The higher discount requires a JCPenney Credit Card or Mastercard. Check official dates and exclusions.

offers.title: Extra 10% off select beauty and salon products
offers.description: Use the online code for eligible JCPenney Beauty and Salon products.
offers.terms: Selected products only. Check the official coupon details for brand exclusions and expiration.
